decision_summary: Retrospective: v0.6.30 converted framework learning from a record count into an auditable governed state transition.
rationale: Visionary: calibration evidence can now challenge QIF itself. Builder: extending the existing calibration package avoided a new package type and kept references executable. Guardian: requiring empirical origin, human acceptance, validation evidence, rollback criteria, and resolved triggers prevents proposals or activity volume from masquerading as learning. The remaining Phase 4 gap is a reproducible calibration report over decision-outcome pairs.
recommendation: Make v0.6.31 Calibration Report records and tooling the next slice: compute Brier score and calibration buckets from honestly labeled decision-outcome pairs, retain uncertainty and sample boundaries, and never auto-produce a quality verdict.
